notes: Single-throttle-body V7, V7 II and V9 applications. The official Piaggio MIU G3 technical-training presentation publishes the RLI, IOLI and RELI tables now recorded here. It does not publish payload widths, byte order, numeric scaling, K-Line initialization, addresses or identification layout. Therefore the known RLI channels are retained only as raw research definitions; physical use and all capabilities are unavailable. RELI 0x21 is explicitly TPS zero-position setting (not a generic throttle-learning guess) and is recorded as a documented operation, but profile-level uncertainty keeps it disabled. IOLI 0x7E adaptation reset and RELI 0x24 P0611 buffer transfer are documented but omitted because their command payload/preconditions are not published.

kline.note: The OEM material establishes K-Line diagnosis and application identifier names, but not baud rate, initialization, addressing, framing, response widths, or scaling.

session.physical_blocked_reason: The official training table defines application identifiers, but not the physical initialization, framing, response widths, or scaling.
session.note: Closed tools implement the missing session details, but compatibility is not a publishable protocol definition.

memory.write_blocked_reason: IAWMIUG3Reader/Writer proves a path exists, but no public source, raw transfer capture, region geometry or verified key algorithm was found.

routines.name: TPS zero-position setting
routines.description: Official MIU G3 RELI 0x21. Sets the throttle-position zero reference.
routines.follow_up: Verify the throttle reading against the service-manual target before starting the engine.
routines.warning: Recorded from the OEM RELI table, but disabled until the enclosing K-Line/session definition is independently validated.
